pages.text: These machine-like block assist in building a clean, efficient, nuclear-oriented factory.

pages.title: Machine Interface
pages.text: The $(item)Machine Interface$() extends a processing machine on one of its sides. It can be used if there is no room for pipes or cables.$(br2)This block is pending in the Forge port.

pages.title: Universal Bin
pages.text: The $(item)Universal Bin$() allows for the simple disposal of anything. It destroys all materials and energy fed to it.$(br2)This block is pending in the Forge port.
